title: Changing a number to a look-alike of an inactive part here is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two parts for this test at the test location: part A, set inactive, with a hyphen in its part number, and part B, active.
  • Use a number to type, number 1: part A's number in lower case with spaces in place of its hyphens, which no Part Library entry has exactly.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part B's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the part B row.
  2. Replace the Part Number with number 1.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Click Cancel.
  5. Type part B's part number in the Search box again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part B.

Step 2:

  • Part Number reads number 1.

Step 3:

  • The change is not saved.
  • A red message reads part A's part number, written as it was saved, followed by "already exists at this location and is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab.", with "Please try to resolve this." under it.
  • It goes away after about 3 seconds, and the window stays open.

Step 4:

  • The window closes.

Step 5:

  • Part B is still listed under its own part number on the Active tab: it kept its number.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 35 (edited 27 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S7-N4: “If a part with the same number is already stocked at this location and is inactive, the save is refused with "{part number} already exists at this location and is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab."”
  • S7-N5b: “S7-N3 and S7-N4 apply when a part is created and when its part number is changed. Saving a part with its number unchanged is never refused by them, even when the location already holds a part whose number matches it.”
  • S7-N5: “For S7-N3 and S7-N4, "the same number" ignores upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods, spaces and other blank characters. The message names the number of the part already there.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “New part's number already stocked here, inactive | "{part number} already exists at this location and is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • S13-N1a: “The save is also refused when another part, at any other location that stocks this part, has a number that matches the typed one, ignoring upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces. The dialog stays open, and the system shows "{existing part number} already exists at {location}." A match at the part's own location is refused with S7-N3 or S7-N4 instead. On the Part Library detail page, which has no current location, S13-N1a applies at every location.”
  • Story 13, context note: “Context note: every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this." Messages the screen builds itself carry their own second line, as listed, or none.”

From: Product's answers to questions 13 to 27 (Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, Google Doc https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pkAPGqWVTdtYorNN4SVNl9HkHxuuB9czro_y2DbUeEM/edit, saved word for word in full-pass-2026-10-27/ANSWERS-13-27-2026-10-27.md), read 28 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, answer 23: “"AB-100 already exists at this location." (S7-N3), or the inactive version (S7-N4) if the AB-100 here is inactive. The "{location}" wording shows only for a clash at another location that stocks the part, or for a rename made on the Part Library page (S13-N1a).”

The design's own words:

Upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces are ignored, and the message names the number of the part already there (S7-N5). The second line, "Please try to resolve this.", is the caption every error toast in the app carries.”
